newsitem.title: GHANA: Volume thin on Ghana bourse, index higher.
newsitem.headline: Volume thin on Ghana bourse, index higher.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share index rose slightly on Monday but few shares changed hands. Exchange officials said that investors were switching to attractive government bonds offered to fight inflation.
The GSE All-Share index rose 0.38 points to 385.40 points from Friday's 385.02.
Turnover slipped to a low 32,790 shares traded compared to a moderate 107,650 on Friday. Offers trailed bids by 274,190 to 4,180,180.
"This is because most investors are shifting their investments into government short-term and risk-free instruments which have fixed high returns," GSE manager Ekow Afedzi told Reuters.
He said that outside institutional investors were showing interest but were reluctant to buy at high prices.
Main gainers on Monday were Ashanti Goldfields Company (+50 cedis to 22,050 cedis), Mechanical Lloyd Company (+10 to 120) and Enterprise Insurance Company (+10 to 550).
Ghana Commercial Bank fell three cedis to 547.
